title: Refine hero motion control and central particle band
outcome: A right-aligned icon-only motion control and a denser, narrower central particle band, preserving the outer ring and hero layout.
acceptance: Central horizontal dot band is visibly denser and slightly narrower; outer ring remains 1.08 + t * 0.01.
Pause control appears on the right without visible wording and retains accessible pause/play and reduced-motion states.
Website verification and focused desktop/mobile browser checks pass.

completion.summary: Right-aligned icon-only pause control and denser, narrower central particle band; outer ring unchanged.
